decision: Did not close the request. The only evidence of completion is an unsourced system note (event-035) and a "completed without payment" flag (event-036); no provider report, photo, invoice or landlord message supports it, and the agency's own instructed provider (Oscar Turner, event-018) never confirmed anything after three chases (event-020, event-022, event-024, event-026). facts.statement: Tenant Eliza Jenkins reported on 21 Feb 2024 that the bedroom window at Flat 24, 150 Copperfield Walk, Kingshaven, ZZ3 7ZZ is not closing properly.
The toilet element of the original report was withdrawn by the tenant on 22 Feb: the tenant said her mother fixed it and only the window needs attention.

The agency asked the landlord on 22 Feb whether to send its own contractor or the landlord's; the landlord's only reply named a plumber for Flat 18, 88 Alder Lane, Willowbank, ZZ3 5ZZ, a different property, and never answered on the window.
On 1 Mar the agency assigned maintenance provider Oscar Turner and briefed tenant and provider; the brief states the provider should only proceed after agency approval if a quote is required.
Three reminders were sent to the provider (4, 6, 8 Mar) with no reply; on 10 Mar the system flagged 3+ reminders with no response.

Every hold note from 11 Mar to 30 May records 'Held awaiting update from Dawson', a name that appears nowhere else on the file; the holds switch from 'Waiting for Provider' to 'Waiting for Landlord' without any new message.

On 11 Jun a system note states the landlord's contractor confirmed the job complete, and the task was marked completed without payment; no provider report, photo, invoice or landlord message supports this.
No landlord standing spend cap or instruction document is on file in this case, so there is no standing authority to spend and no landlord approval of window works exists.
No gas, electrical, water, heating, damp/mould or occupant-vulnerability content appears anywhere in the file; the tenant did not report the property as insecure.
The tenant was acknowledged within one working day of the report (22 Feb) and updated again on 22 Feb and 1 Mar.
